camel_example: aliyun sas DescribeImageBuildRiskList --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 20 --CurrentPage 1 --CriteriaType RiskKeyName --Lang zh --Criteria no_user --RiskLevel medium
description_en: Queries the summary of image build risks by using paging
description_zh: 分页查询镜像构建风险汇总概要
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-image-build-risk-list --criteria no_user --criteria-type RiskKeyName --risk-level medium --lang zh --current-page 1 --page-size 20 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeImageBuildRiskList

parameters.help_en:
The rule name or category name of the build risk. You can call the [DescribeImageBuildRiskList](~~~~) operation to obtain the value. Valid values:
If CriteriaType is set to RiskKeyName, the value is the rule name of the build risk.
If CriteriaType is set to RiskClassName, the value is the category name of the build risk
parameters.help_zh:
构建风险的规则名称或分类名称，通过接口[DescribeImageBuildRiskList](~~~~)来获取。可选参数：
当CriteriaType为RiskKeyName时，目标对象值为构建风险的规则名称。
当CriteriaType为RiskClassName时，目标对象值为构建风险的分类名称
parameters.name: criteria

parameters.help_en:
The query type of the build risk. Valid values:
RiskKeyName: build risk rule name.
RiskClassName: build risk category name
parameters.help_zh:
构建风险的查询类型。取值：
RiskKeyName：构建风险规则名称。
RiskClassName：构建风险分类名称
parameters.name: criteria_type

parameters.help_en:
The risk level. Valid values:

high: High.

medium: Medium.

low: Low
parameters.help_zh:
风险等级。取值：

high：高危

medium：中危

low：低危
parameters.name: risk_level

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content in the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认值zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page when paging is used. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page when paging is used. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned per page.
Do not leave PageSize empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

Code.description_en: The result code. A value of 200 indicates success. Any other value indicates failure. You can use this field to determine the cause of the failure
Code.description_zh: 结果代码，200表示成功，若为别的值则表示失败，调用方可根据此字段判断失败原因

List.description_en: The summary list of build risks

items.description_en: The list of data packets that match the filter conditions
items.description_zh: 满足过滤条件的数据包列表

FirstScanTime.description_en: The timestamp of the first scan. Unit: milliseconds
FirstScanTime.description_zh: 首次扫描时间戳，单位：毫秒

LastScanTime.description_en: The timestamp of the most recent scan. Unit: milliseconds
LastScanTime.description_zh: 最新扫描的时间戳，单位：毫秒

RiskClass.description_en: The key of the build risk rule category

RiskClassName.description_en: The category name of the build risk rule

RiskKey.description_en: The key of the build risk rule. You can call the [DescribeImageBuildRiskList](~~~~) operation to obtain the value of RiskKey

RiskKeyName.description_en: The name of the build risk rule

low: Low
